model_name: INCOIS Bio-ROMS (IBR) Indian Ocean surface fields

model_source.title: INCOIS Bio-ROMS (IBR) Indian Ocean surface fields
model_source.institution: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)
model_source.vertical_levels: surface only (no subsurface levels in source)

method.observation: shallowest QC-good level with depth <= 10.0 m of each ascending profile
method.spatial: bilinear on native IBR grid; all four corners must be ocean
method.vertical: IBR provides surface fields only; no vertical interpolation performed

provenance.model_source: INCOIS Bio-ROMS (IBR) Indian Ocean surface fields (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13802393)
provenance.collocation_method: observation: shallowest QC-good level with depth <= 10.0 m of each ascending profile; temporal: nearest IBR timestep, |dt| <= 15.0 days; spatial: bilinear on native IBR grid; all four corners must be ocean; vertical: IBR provides surface fields only; no vertical interpolation performed
provenance.qc_mode: Argo QC flags 1 and 2 only; adjusted values for A/D data modes

reason: No temporal overlap: float profiles span 2025-04-24 .. 2026-08-08; IBR model coverage is 1980-01-24 .. 2019-12-25.
